sentences.en: At noon, my classmate and I went to a restaurant to eat noodles.
The server asked how many bowls we wanted; I said two bowls.

t: in a moment; a short while
sentences.en: The noodles were delicious, and I finished mine in no time.
I was still hungry, and said to the server: "One more bowl!"
After I finished that bowl, my classmate said: "You're eating so much today!"
I said: "It's so delicious! One more bowl, please — is that okay?"

vocab: in a moment; a short while

quiz.q: How many bowls of noodles does the narrator order at first?
Why does the narrator ask the server for 再来一碗?
What does the narrator ask for at the very end?

grammar.p: 再来 + 数量（bring/give me one more...）
grammar.e: 再来 is a quick, colloquial way to ask for another one, often used when ordering food.
grammar.x: 服务员，再来一碗！— One more bowl, please!

grammar.p: 再要 + 数量，可以吗？（asking politely for one more）
grammar.e: 再要 followed by a quantity, plus 可以吗, politely asks to get one more.
grammar.x: 再要一碗，可以吗？— One more bowl, is that okay?

grammar.p: 一会儿 + 就 + verb（in no time, ...）
grammar.e: 一会儿 followed by 就 shows something happens quickly, after only a short while.
grammar.x: 我一会儿就吃完了。— I finished it in no time.
